text:
Elaine: hi team, first day! quick help — I don't have HubSpot/Gong/Aircall seats yet and SSO is failing on MFA. who do I ping to get these provisioned? :wave:

Sarah (sales-ops): welcome Elaine :tada: I'll take point on seats. can you DM me your manager and preferred phone number? also need full name as you want it in Gong and HubSpot.

Elaine: thanks Sarah — james is my manager (james). number is +1 415-555-0198. full name Elaine Park.

James (manager): yep confirmed, please provision CRM + sales tools. we need Gong access for call reviews and Aircall for dialing. priority: HubSpot > Aircall > Gong.

Sarah (sales-ops): got it. filing seat requests now. FYI we have two HubSpot seat types — "AE" and "CSD". which role are you in?

Elaine: CSD (customer success).

Sarah (sales-ops): perfect. I opened tickets: IT-#4729 (HubSpot seat), IT-#4730 (Aircall), IT-#4731 (Gong). ETA for seats usually 24-48hrs during weekdays. I'll ping if anything blocks.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Elaine! :sparkles: Please complete the "New Hire Sales Tech" checklist: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/checklists/sales-new-hire. Add your preferred calendar availability to this doc within 48h.

Elaine: quick note — SSO when I try to sign in to the HubSpot SSO page it errors with "MFA required but not configured". it doesn't give me a setup flow.

Matt (it-ops): Elaine — can you try SSO again and paste the full error screenshot? sometimes our Okta policy needs you in the "sales-team" group. I’ll check group membership. Also which device/browser are you on?

Elaine: using macbook, Chrome Version 111, attaching screenshot in thread (uploaded).

Matt (it-ops): saw screenshot. you aren't in the sales-team Okta group yet. I’ll add you now. after that, log out of SSO and log back in. then it should prompt to set up Duo MFA.

Sarah (sales-ops): Aircall note — install the Aircall Chrome extension and register with company email. If you get "no seat available" message, reply here and I'll approve the seat from our license pool. Quick how-to: 1) go to https://chrome.google.com/webstore 2) search "Aircall" 3) install extension 4) sign in with company SSO.

Tyler: For Gong access, we need your company email + timezone. Also add 2 sample recordings to your "shadow" folder once you have access — helps us during ramp. Link to CSD playbook: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/cs-first-30-days — contains call templates and common objection scripts.

Elaine: thanks all. one more — where do I find the onboarding collateral (case studies / one-pagers) for CS calls?

Sarah (sales-ops): collateral lives in the Sales Drive: https://drive.redwood.example.com/sales/collateral. suggest: start with "CS-Intro-OnePager.pdf" and "SLA-talk-track.md". I’ll share folder with you once HubSpot/Drive perms are in place.

Matt (it-ops): Elaine — I added you to sales-team group at 1767554356. try SSO now.

Elaine: SSO worked, prompted to enroll Duo, enrolled and I'm in. HubSpot page loads now. thank you! :relieved:

Sarah (sales-ops): quick follow-up: IT-#4729 shows HubSpot seat provisioned (CSD). IT-#4730 Aircall pending approval from license owner — I approved it, should be active in ~2hrs. IT-#4731 Gong invite sent — accept email to finish setup.

James (manager): awesome — welcome aboard Elaine. let's do a 30m sync tomorrow 10am to run through playbook and first week goals.

Elaine: perfect, added to calendar. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
